
// (type any)
type Type_any struct {
 backref    any
 refcount   int
 P_type     *Type_type
 P_const    *Type_const
 P_msgblock *Type_msgblock
 P_delta    *Type_delta
 P_isrun    bool
}

// V_any_constructor
func V_any_constructor() *Type_any {
 var output *Type_any = new(Type_any)
 return output
}

// V_any_create
func V_any_create() *Type_any {
 var output *Type_any = V_any_constructor()
 V_any_initialize(
  output)
 return output
}

// V_any_initialize
func V_any_initialize(
 value *Type_any) {
 value.P_type = T_any
 value.backref = value
}

// V_any_shutdown
func V_any_shutdown(
 value *Type_any) {
 value.backref = nil
 var type_msgblock *Type_msgblock = value.P_msgblock
 if type_msgblock != E_msgblock {
  value.P_msgblock = E_msgblock
  V_release_any(
   type_msgblock.type_any)
 }
 var type_const *Type_const = value.P_const
 if type_const != E_const {
  value.P_const = E_const
  V_release_any(
   type_const.type_any)
 }
 value.P_type = E_type
 V_global_release()
}

// V_any_startup
func V_any_startup() *Type_type {
 var t_variable *Type_type = T_any
 var e_variable *Type_any = E_any
 V_any_initialize(
  e_variable)
 V_type_t_startup(
  t_variable,
  "vx/core",
  "any",
  E_string,
  e_variable)
 t_variable.P_propertylist = V_varlist_from_listvar(
  []*Type_var{
   V_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
    "backref",
    T_any),
   V_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
    "refcount",
    T_intn),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "type",
    T_type),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "const",
    T_const),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "msgblock",
    T_msgblock),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "delta",
    T_delta),
   V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
    "isrun",
    T_booleann)})
 var output *Type_type = t_variable
 return output
}

// V_any_from_type_backref
func V_any_from_type_backref(
 type_type *Type_type,
 backref any) *Type_any {
 var output *Type_any = V_any_create()
 output.P_type = type_type
 output.backref = backref
 return output
}

// V_copy_any
func V_copy_any(
 type_any *Type_any,
 type_anylist *Type_anylist) *Type_any {
 var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
  type_any)
 var output *Type_any = type_generic.P_copy_funcn(
  type_any,
  type_anylist)
 return output
}

// V_new_any
func V_new_any(
 type_type *Type_type,
 type_anylist *Type_anylist) *Type_any {
 var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_type(
  type_type)
 var output *Type_any = type_generic.P_new_funcn(
  type_type,
  type_anylist)
 return output
}

// V_release_any
func V_release_any(
 type_any *Type_any) {
 type_any.refcount -= 1
 if type_any.refcount <= 0 {
  if type_any.refcount < 0 {
   V_log_liststringn(
    []string{
     "Error: Negative Refcount - ",
     V_typenamen_from_any(
      type_any)})
  }
  V_shutdown_any(
   type_any)
 }
}

// V_shutdown_any
func V_shutdown_any(
 type_any *Type_any) {
 var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
  type_any)
 type_generic.P_shutdown_funcn(
  type_any)
}

// V_any_cast_any
func V_any_cast_any(
 type_type *Type_type,
 type_any *Type_any) *Type_any {
 var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_type(
  type_type)
 var output *Type_any = type_generic.P_any_cast_any_funcn(
  type_type,
  type_any)
 return output
}

// V_empty_from_any
func V_empty_from_any(
 type_any *Type_any) *Type_any {
 var type_type *Type_type = Vx_Core.V_type_from_any(
  type_any)
 var output *Type_any = V_empty(
  type_type)
 return output
}

// V_release_listany
func V_release_listany(
 listany []*Type_any) {
 for _, type_any := range listany {
  V_release_any(
  type_any)
 }
}

// V_release_listany_except
func V_release_listany_except(
	listany []*Type_any,
	except_any *Type_any) {
	for _, type_any := range listany {
		if type_any != except_any {
			V_release_any(
				type_any)
	 	}
	}
}

// V_reserve_any
func V_reserve_any(
	type_any *Type_any) {
	type_any.refcount += 1
}

// v_reserve_listany
func v_reserve_listany(
	listany []*Type_any) {
	for _, type_any := range listany {
		V_reserve_any(
			type_any)
	}
}

var T_any *Type_type = V_type_constructor()
var E_any *Type_any = V_any_constructor()
